identity.title: Antifreeze in the hot core of Orion. First detection of ethylene glycol in <ASTROBJ>Orion-KL</ASTROBJ>

paper_type_evidence.quote: We primarily use here the ALMA Science Verification (ALMA-SV) data taken on 20 January 2012 towards the IRc2 region in Orion.

evidence.quote: The observations were centred on coordinates ($\alpha_{J2000}$ = 05$^{h}$35$^{m}$14$s$35, $\delta_{J2000}$ = $-$05$\ensuremath{^\circ}$22$\ensuremath{'}$35$\ensuremath{''}$00)

question.value: Is ethylene glycol (aGg' and gGg' conformers) detectable in Orion-KL hot core, and how do its abundance relative to methanol, ethanol and glycolaldehyde compare with Sgr B2 and comets?

evidence.quote: In this paper, we report the results of our search for the two most stable conformers of ethylene glycol towards .
This paper makes use of the following ALMA data: ADS/JAO.ALMA#2011.0.00009.SV.
The observations were carried out with 16 x 12 m antennas in the Band 6 frequency range from 213.715 to 246.627 GHz.

frequencies_and_spectral_setup.value: 20 overlapping spectral windows, 1.875 GHz each, 3840 channels, 0.488 MHz (0.64 km/s) spacing

evidence.quote: 20 slightly overlapping spectral windows were observed, each with a 1.875 GHz bandwidth and 3 840 channels resulting in a 0.488 MHz channel spacing
The observations were carried out with 16 x 12 m antennas
The synthesized beam is 1.90$\ensuremath{''}$ $\times$ 1.40$\ensuremath{''}$ with a PA of 170$\ensuremath{^\circ}$
taken on 20 January 2012 towards the IRc2 region in Orion
We primarily use here the ALMA Science Verification (ALMA-SV) data

provided.value: Earlier interferometric data (Favre et al. 2011) used for comparison; blended lines discarded; continuum comparison

evidence.quote: We also analyzed several observational data sets obtained with the IRAM Plateau de Bure Interferometer (cite: Favre:2011a).

what.value: CDMS spectroscopy for ethylene glycol conformers

evidence.quote: We used the most recent CDMS data to search for transitions for the *aGg’* and *gGg’* conformers in the ALMA-SV data cube.

what.value: Column densities for Sgr B2, NGC 7129, comets used in comparison table

evidence.quote: Table [\[comp-sgrB2\]](#comp-sgrB2) compares the column densities derived for ethylene glycol and related molecules towards , two other prominent interstellar sources and the 3 comets

task.value: GILDAS line map cleaning with CLARK algorithm

evidence.quote: The line maps were cleaned using the CLARK algorithm (cite: Clark:1980).

continuum_subtraction.value: Subtraction of continuum built from carefully selected line-free channels

evidence.quote: The continuum emission was subtracted in the maps by carefully selecting line-free channels (see Sect. [5](#sec:continuum)).

evidence.quote: we have separated each one of the 20 spectral windows into four 1 000-channel sub-windows, and we have searched for line-free channels in each sub-window
The synthesized beam is 1.90$\ensuremath{''}$ $\times$ 1.40$\ensuremath{''}$ with a PA of 170$\ensuremath{^\circ}$

method.value: Initial processing in CASA, visibilities exported to GILDAS, line maps cleaned with CLARK

evidence.quote: We used the CASA software for initial processing, and then we exported visibilities to the GILDAS package for further analysis.

analysis_steps.goal: Subtract continuum and make continuum cube

method.value: Select line-free channel pairs per sub-window by channel max-min intensity and noise of pair difference; average best pair

evidence.quote: Then we obtained the continuum map for a given sub-window by averaging the two channel maps of the best pair.

validation.value: Checked coherence of continuum maps of adjacent sub-windows; compared with PdBI

evidence.quote: Finally, we checked the coherence of the continuum maps obtained for adjacent sub-windows.

analysis_steps.goal: Identify ethylene glycol lines and spatial distribution

method.value: Search CDMS aGg' and gGg' transitions predicted at 120 K; compare profiles and integrated maps of the least-blended lines

evidence.quote: From line intensity predictions at 120 K, a typical temperature for the region (cite: Favre:2011a), we have examined the strongest lines among the ethylene glycol transitions

fitting.value: Gaussian fit of normalized profiles: 7.6 km/s centre, 2.3 km/s width

evidence.quote: They can be fitted with a Gaussian centred at a velocity of 7.6 km s$^{-1}$ and a line width of 2.3 km s$^{-1}$.

validation.value: Snyder et al. criteria plus spatial coherence across transitions

evidence.quote: For interferometric observations, another criterion can be added: the coherence of the spatial distribution.

method.value: Rotational diagram at emission peak from less-contaminated lines

evidence.quote: The rotational diagram is obtained at the emission peak from the less-contaminated ethylene glycol lines to derive reliable physical parameters
Taking the partition function *Q*(*T*) = 234 500 from the nonlinear plot of the CDMS values of *Q* at 145 K
Assuming optically thin lines and local thermodynamic equilibrium

validation.value: Synthetic spectrum overlaid on observed spectrum

evidence.quote: Figure [6](#spesyn) shows the synthetic spectrum overlaid on the observed ALMA spectrum towards the ethylene glycol peak

method.value: Compare gGg' synthetic spectrum with observed spectrum at aGg' peak at 145 K and 250 K

evidence.quote: we have also derived a synthetic spectrum at the *aGg’* peak for a temperature of 250 K

assumptions.value: Same spatial distribution, temperature and partition function as aGg'

evidence.quote: We have further assumed here that the partition functions of both conformers are identical

evidence.quote: We compared the maps of these tracers using the Aladin software
we obtain a rotational temperature of 145$\pm$30 K
total column density averaged over the synthesized beam *N*$\rm_{\textit{aGg'}}$ of 4.6$\pm$0.8 10$^{15}~$cm$^{-2}$

findings_qualitative.value: Ethylene glycol emission is compact, peaks ~2" SW of the main continuum peak and differs from other O-bearing species

evidence.quote: The emission is compact and peaks towards the Hot Core close to the main continuum peak, about 2$\ensuremath{''}$ to the south-west

claims.hypothesis: Is aGg' ethylene glycol detected in Orion-KL?
claims.experiment: Line search in ALMA-SV Band 6 cube with profile and map coherence
claims.result: Many partially blended lines plus one unblended at 228752 MHz share peak position and profile

evidence.quote: We detected the *aGg’* conformer of ethylene glycol in Orion KL.

claims.hypothesis: Is ethylene glycol relative to methanol similar to comets?
claims.experiment: Compare column density ratios with Sgr B2, NGC 7129 and three comets
claims.finding: Interstellar abundance far below comets, outside the known correlation

evidence.quote: We confirm with that the ethylene glycol abundance in interstellar sources is much lower than in the three comets where it has been detected with a ratio in the range 0.1–0.15.

claims.result: Only weak lines, strong ones blended

evidence.quote: Hence we conclude that the *gGg’* conformer is not detected in our study

why_this_data.value: High spatial resolution reduces line confusion and wide bandwidth gives many transitions

evidence.quote: Furthermore, a large spectral bandwidth is needed because many individual transitions are required to securely detect large organic molecules.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: PdBI lines discarded because of blending and different resolution

evidence.quote: we have discarded these lines from the present analysis because of line blending problems

limitations_admitted.value: Hypotheses for gGg' upper limit admittedly questionable; lines too few and weak to dispel confusion

evidence.quote: Making the simplifying, but admittedly questionable, hypotheses

referee_caveats_inferred: Almost all lines blended; single unblended line, so LTE temperature rests on partially blended lines
Uncertainties on N and T not described in detail
No beam dilution/source size correction; calibration uncertainty not discussed
Comparison across sources with different resolutions

reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: Imaging recipe is incomplete and line blending requires judgement.
